columns.kind: Priorities | Rules | Manner | Identity | Confidence | Facts | Circumstances | Process | Model | Structure | Premises
columns.verbs: subset of {attest, authorize, replace, withdraw, recant}
columns.maintains_record: bool: the row is itself the evidence that something happened; fixes erasure and projection
columns.reference: none | pre:<kind|any> | carry:<kind> (the row it names; only a carry is a cell of the carries grid)
columns.signer_rule: {self | owner_of_subject | seat_role(duty) | roster_member(at) | minter | steward | any_registered} x via {none | delegates_to(scope, depth, term, caps)} x conditions ⊆ {adult, capacitated, not_subject, not_author}
columns.subject_rule: {subject_kind, cardinality, must_be_registered, for_key_id ∈ {none, serve_seat, recipient}, in_audience, attested_party, subject_blind}
columns.body: CDDL reference beyond the signed object; an existence_only audience names a two-part shape
columns.lifecycle: {withdraws_by ⊆ {attester, subject, cosigned}, retraction_class ∈ {peer, duty_record, authority_act, cosigned}, supersedes ∈ {same_attester, none}, expires, rotation_on_removal}
columns.replication: {tier ∈ {local, cohort, federation}, audience ∈ {cohort, cohort_plus_subjects(full|existence_only), addressee, everyone}, non_recipient ∈ {drop, hold_sealed}, held ∈ {settle_on_key, refuse}}
columns.derived: projection_id | none (the row must equal the named projection's rebuild)
columns.confers: trust | duty | standing | nothing (read by the trust-set fold, never by admission)

Census-only readings ride beside the CC columns as verbs_code, maintains_record_code, reference_code and reserved. A ruled version replaces every generic, prose, mixed and gap cell with a closed value and refuses what remains.
